3968-4050-4078-6094.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
3968-4050-4078-6094.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

5256-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5256-7936--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

719-4302-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-4302-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
719-4302-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3817-3991-8095.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-3641-5231.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3641-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5315-7913--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-7913--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Iron Lad.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

413-4986-7896--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Mirkwood Nurturer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mirkwood Nurturer enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Mirkwood Nurturer trigger, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Mirkwood Nurturer
Repeat.
413-4986-7896--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

4399-4518-6626-6752.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-6626-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

215-539-1336-7781.description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Heronblade Elite
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2445-3099-3334-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Lae'zel and Branching Evolution.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

206-222-527-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
206-222-527-6798.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1117-2866-4668-6518.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
1117-2866-4668-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

104-3490-4716-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4716-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

539-1315-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3234-3293-5686-6620.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5686-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.
3234-3293-5686-6620.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2034-2534-4679-6821.description:
Cast Jump Scare by paying {W}, targeting Coercive Recruiter.
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Coercive Recruiter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

5231-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
5231-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Repeat from step 3.

643-3951-5703-6753.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-3951-5703-6753.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2034-3372-5295-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-5295-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

527-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-2608-4499.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Selvala.
Repeat.

1987-3277-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3277-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake.
When Izzet Chronarch and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3277-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

4613-5636-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one permanent card in hand.
Evolution Witness has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-5636-5660.description:
Activate Evolution Witness using Psychic Frog's first ability by discarding a permanent card, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-3986-4068.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
3259-3986-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

536-1061-4313.notablePrerequisites: You have the city's blessing and/or control at least eight permanents.
536-1061-4313.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing and control ten or more permanents, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, Flameshadow Conjuring triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {3} or {U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

880-3703-3875.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Sporemound trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Sporemound trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

141-3495-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3495-4050.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3495-4050.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

2047-2751-4659.notablePrerequisites: Mechanized Production attached to Strionic Resonator.
2047-2751-4659.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Resolve the copy of Mechanized Production's ability, creating a token copy of Strionic Resonator.
Activate the Strionic Resonator token by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the Mechanized Production trigger.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Strionic Resonator token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2385-3681-4703-5026.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Brallin.
You have at least seven cards in hand.
2385-3681-4703-5026.description:
Cast Change of Fortune by paying {3}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Change of Fortune.
Resolve the copy of Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Resolve the original Change of Fortune, discarding your hand and drawing cards equal to the number of cards you've discarded this turn.
Brallin triggers for each card discarded, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself and giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

2184-2232-2858-3273.description:
Pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice putting Chandra, Flame's Fury onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Torch of Defiance to your hand.
+1 Chandra, Flame's Fury targeting an opponent.
Then pay {R} to activate Planebound Accomplice once again, putting Chandra, Torch of Defiance onto the battlefield.
Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Chandra, Flame's Fury to your hand.
+1 Chandra adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

2436-3464-3657.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Marwyn.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2436-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

413-1992-4419.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
413-1992-4419.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping and sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station and Renata triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping itself.
Resolve Renata's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability by dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

539-3814-4291.notablePrerequisites: Argothian Elder and Prodigal Sorcerer do not have summoning sickness.
539-3814-4291.description:
Activate Prodigal Sorcerer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping itself and Prodigal Sorcerer.
Repeat.

738-1202-2034-3370.description:
Sacrifice Myr Moonvessel to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Moonvessel and Butcher of Malakir trigger.
Resolve Myr Moonvessel's trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve Butcher of Malakir's trigger, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Myr Moonvessel to your hand.
Cast Myr Moonvessel by paying {1}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.

867-1640.notablePrerequisites:
Jackal Pup has indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Jackal Pup.
867-1640.description:
Deal damage to Jackal Pup.
Jackal Pup triggers, attempting to deal damage to you, but dealing damage to Jackal Pup instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat step 2 in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.
